Metadata.title: AMS Airport Ride — Schiphol Taxi with Fixed Price
Metadata.description: Book your Schiphol taxi with a fixed price from €35. Also for regular taxi rides within Amsterdam and between Dutch cities. Pay easily after your ride.

TopBar.freeCancellation: Free cancellation up to 3 hours in advance

Hero.label2: Flight number? We account for delays
Hero.title: Taxi to Schiphol.
Hero.subtitle: Your price is fixed before you book — even at night, on weekends, or in traffic. Add your flight number and we'll take any delay into account. Booking takes 30 seconds.
Hero.compactTrustLine: No surcharges · Luggage included · Free cancellation up to 3 hours ahead

FlightMonitor.label: How we account for your flight — example
FlightMonitor.disclaimer: Example display — enter your own flight number when booking and we'll account for the actual delay.

TwoColumnBanner.amsterdamBody: From Amsterdam West to the city centre and every other district. Calculate your ride price based on distance and travel time.
TwoColumnBanner.schipholBody: After a long journey, you want to get to your destination quickly and comfortably. Your driver will contact you as soon as you clear customs.

PaymentTrust.title: Pay when you arrive
PaymentTrust.body: Pay directly to your driver by card or cash.
PaymentTrust.receipt: A receipt is available in the taxi.
